name: Bánh ướt lòng gà
summary: Soft rice sheets with chicken and chicken offal, a Da Lat morning plate rather than the usual pork cakes.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note calls bánh ướt lòng gà a Da Lat dish of long standing.
texture: The same note calls the sheets white, soft, and chewy.
howToEat: The note says Da Lat does not serve these sheets with chả lụa, nem chua, nem nướng, or chả quế. The plate is chicken: shredded meat, breast bone, thigh, offal, and trứng non.
Fish sauce is on the plate. The note says it is not overly salty, and chili is there if you want heat.
where: Quán Long, hẻm 202, lô A16 KQH Phan Đình Phùng. Bánh ướt lòng gà Đà Lạt (Hằng), 68 Phan Đình Phùng, which also sells bột chiên, xắp xắp, and bánh bèo. Quán Chip Chip, 28 Tăng Bạt Hổ. Quán Trang, 15F Tăng Bạt Hổ. Hours are Check on arrival.
priceBand: Visit Lâm Đồng prints 30,000 to above 45,000 VND at Long, 27,000–35,000 VND at Hằng, 25,000–100,000 VND at Chip Chip, and 35,000–45,000 VND at Trang. The figures are not averaged.
